description: Figure 7(b), labeled “Agency A,” is a pie chart illustrating the distribution of different task types across turns from verified Wildchat journalist-LLM conversations. The chart is divided into three segments: “Article generation” (82.9%), shown in red; “Article editing” (14.6%), shown in blue; and “Headline generation” (2.4%), shown in yellow. Each segment is clearly labeled with its corresponding task type and percentage value directly within the chart. The chart does not include a legend, and the segments are arranged in descending order of size, with “Article generation” occupying the largest portion of the circle.
